description: Minecraft fabric mod for biome generation control

mods.name: Biome Rings
mods.description: Generate the overworld biomes in rings based on distance from spawn!

releases.notes:
Minecraft 1.21.1 · Fabric · requires Fabric API

## Terrain manipulation
- Rings now shape the **terrain**, not only the biome: continentalness, erosion and weirdness are steered inside each ring, so plains rings go flat, peak rings rise and ocean rings flood.
- Terrain profiles per ring: `auto` (from the biome's vanilla climate), presets (`flat`, `hills`, `mountains`, `peaks`, `coast`, `ocean`, `deep_ocean`), `none`, or explicit ranges.
- Optional temperature/humidity steering so vanilla picks the ring biome on its own.
- Smooth slopes between rings (`terrain.blend_width`); `terrain.enabled: false` keeps the old swap-only behavior.

## Config v2
- New layout: `shape`, `terrain`, `biome_swap`, `rings` (weighted biomes, optional `replace` list), `debug`.
- A v1 config is saved as `config/biomerings.v1.json` and replaced by test defaults.

## Other
- Ring shape is seeded per world.
- Faster biome lookups (reuses vanilla's climate sample, precompiled rules).
- Cave biomes are left alone unless `biome_swap.affect_caves` is on.
- Debug commands: `/biomerings here`, `/biomerings rings`.
- Fixed distance overflow past ~46k blocks.

Terrain changes apply to newly generated chunks; use a new world.
